subject: I-O status
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 9.1.13.2 "A READ statement for a line sequential file has successfully executed but a line delimiter or the end-of-file has not been detected" -> OK §9.1.13.2 5)). SequentialConnector.Read line arm: a physical line longer than MaxRecordSize is truncated, the remainder kept as the FPI (_lineRemainder, §14.9.30.4 GR15 NOTE 3) and the status is '06'; a line of exactly the maximum size has its delimiter detected and is '00'. Probe out/probe/iostat-rel: line 'ABCDEFG' into X(5) -> 06 [ABCDE], next READ -> 00 [FG] (the delimiter is detected on the remainder read); out/probe/iostat-seq: an undelimited 27-char stream gives 06 on every READ until the tail. '09' outranks '06' when both apply (GR16 stated after GR15) - see GR-9.1.13.2-7. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2023 (line sequential organization is new in 2023 - §12.4.5.10.3; ConstructRegistry file-organization-line-sequential-2023)
